components.name: Continue Session
components.description: Outlined continuation action; sample text is illustrative.
components.css: .ds-continue{width:100%;max-width:440px;background:#102e23;color:#e9eee5;border:1px solid #42614d;border-radius:9px;text-align:left;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;font:14px Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease;}.ds-continue strong,.ds-continue small{display:block}.ds-continue small{color:#a8bdad;margin-top:5px}.ds-continue-icon{font-size:19px;color:#61d8b8}.ds-continue-arrow{margin-left:auto;color:#d9bf80;font-size:18px}.ds-continue:hover{background:#102e23}.ds-continue:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #77e5c9;outline-offset:3px;}.ds-continue:active{filter:brightness(.9)}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){button,select{transition:none}}

components.name: Independent Focus Panel
components.description: Prototype focus panel; its control is illustrative and not connected.
components.html:
Independent focus

Work on your own.

Start a focus session without opening AGY. Your task stays open when you stop.
components.css: .ds-focus{max-width:288px;border:1px solid #5b6442;border-radius:10px;padding:18px;background:#10291f;color:#e9eee5;font:14px Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-focus-kicker{color:#d9bf80;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.ds-focus h2{font:600 22px Georgia,serif;margin:8px 0 10px}.ds-focus p{color:#b5c9b7;line-height:1.5;font-size:12px}.ds-focus label{display:grid;gap:7px;margin-top:20px;font-size:12px;color:#a8bdad}.ds-focus select{color:#deeadf;border:1px solid #496657;background:#102c22;border-radius:6px;padding:9px;font:14px Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-focus button{width:100%;text-align:left;margin-top:10px;background:#61d8b8;color:#09251b;border:1px solid #61d8b8;border-radius:7px;padding:10px 15px;font:700 14px Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease;}.ds-focus button:hover{background:#8ae8ce}.ds-focus button:focus-visible,.ds-focus select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #77e5c9;outline-offset:3px;}.ds-focus button:active{filter:brightness(.9)}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){button,select{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
TGM is focused, welcoming, and practical. Its controls feel familiar and restrained, with clear feedback and a compact desktop layout. Use the selected Codex concept as the visual reference, and prioritize clear tasks over decoration.

This is a record of a disposable prototype, not a claim that production components or complete accessibility states exist. The palette and flat, layered character are confirmed; exact values below are extracted from the prototype and should be validated as the real application is built.
keyCharacteristics: Deep forest-green surfaces with warm gold details and mint-teal actions.
Clear navigation, restrained controls, and compact project context.
Thin borders and tonal layering rather than prominent shadows.
Serif headings paired with familiar, readable sans-serif controls.
dos: Do keep controls familiar, focus indicators visible, and feedback clear.
Do use dark-green tonal layers, warm gold details, and teal selectively for prominent actions.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences and test the real interface at relevant Windows sizes.
donts: Don't present simulated integrations or sample data as real activity.
Don't treat prototype measurements or incomplete states as proof of production readiness.
